features: Banner section with caption, heading, button, and background media
Full width or boxed layout with customizable spacing
Multiple background and content color presets
shortDescription: The Product Slider Showcase combines a promotional banner with a product carousel to draw attention to featured collections. The leading banner supports background images, captions, flags, headings, and call-to-action buttons—ideal for seasonal campaigns or curated selections. Product tiles follow with full customization of displayed information including flags, brand, description, and add-to-cart actions. Layout options range from full-width immersive to contained boxed styles.
